title: HUMMBL CLP Knowledge Ledger
description: Cognitive Ledger Protocol shared memory and knowledge compiler

entries.title: Decouple CLP Core to Zero Third-Party Runtime Dependencies
entries.content: All core CLP ledger mechanisms (ledger_writer, query, indexer, schema_validator, models) must strictly execute on standard library Python 3.11+. Third party imports (such as sqlite3 extras or pydantic) are forbidden in the core runtime to ensure air-gapped embedded execution.

entries.title: Dual Author-Committer Identity for Governed Agents
entries.content: Automated git commits from governed agents must maintain hummbl-dev as author and the specific agent key (agy, codex, devin) as committer. This guarantees clean accountability in git log and compliance with rules/agent-commit-identity.md.

entries.title: Content Scanner Filter for Invisible Unicode and Homoglyphs
entries.content: Identified 42 dangerous Unicode codepoints (including zero-width spaces, directional overrides, and Cyrillic homoglyphs) that can bypass naive text filters. Implemented NFC normalization and fail-closed codepoint scanning before writing any ledger entry.

entries.title: Atomic File Replacement via os.replace
entries.content: On Windows and POSIX hosts, concurrent writes to ledger.jsonl and state.json risk file corruption if process terminates during flush. Always write to a unique temporary file in the same directory, execute fsync, and call os.replace for guaranteed atomic swap.

entries.title: Stigmergic Inverted Index Frequency Decay
entries.content: Original BM25 indexer boosted frequently retrieved entries linearly without upper bound, causing retrieval lock-in. Implemented logarithmic decay and recency discount to maintain diversity across long-horizon agent trajectories.

entries.title: Initial Linear Frequency Boost for CLP BM25 Index
entries.content: Prototyped retrieval frequency tracking to give higher weight to frequently accessed memories. Proved effective in short test sessions.
